goal: A3 authenticated Codex session lifecycle integration
scope: A-owned runtime integration only; no live provider turn, delivery, workshop, or capture
implementation: Host configuration is disabled by default and requires explicit Codex enablement, consent, executable, model, effort, time/token bounds, and a separate state directory.

The authenticated system.codex.refresh command is the only path that invokes agent.capabilities. It caches sanitized model/account readiness for ten minutes against a host configuration fingerprint; ordinary status/capability reads launch no provider process.

Only a canonical stored typed-source build profile with read_repo/propose_patch/run_checks, candidate.frozen_identity, a bounded write scope, and positive budget can dispatch. Public execution_profile is host-derived. job.resume requires fresh readiness, current source identity, uncertain positive reservation, and the same persisted provider thread.

Typed thread/turn progress is request-bound, sequence-checked, bounded, persisted before a generic public event, and never exposes provider IDs to renderer-facing events. Startup interruption becomes ambiguous; no automatic retry creates a replacement turn.

The scheduler connects B repo inspection/preparation and agent.execute to frozen candidate import and D frozen-identity verification. Candidate files and linked artifacts are hash-checked into runtime-owned storage. Unknown provider USD cost stays NULL/uncertain and the reservation remains held.

runtime_test_coverage: explicit cached capability refresh and zero status dispatch
session persistence, generic public events, exact bounded provider-ID contract
restart ambiguity and explicit same-attempt/thread resume without a second reservation
pause interrupts a running fake session, retains uncertain reservation and does not retry
fake-only end-to-end scheduler candidate and frozen-identity path with unknown USD cost
A2 API, paging, auth, storage, policy, concurrency, process-group cleanup, and disposable B/D fixture pipeline
validation.tools_test_coverage: Fake app-server transport, capability probe with no thread/turn calls, consent/config gates, cancellation/resume, credential isolation, safe progress, candidate freeze, Git filters, and protocol validation.

readiness.native_app_server: blocked before initialize response by read-only Codex state under host CODEX_HOME
readiness.fixture_status: All A lifecycle pipeline tests inject fake adapters; B app-server tests use fake JSON-RPC transport and disposable repositories.

limits: USD cost is not independently verified by the installed app-server; the reservation remains held, but max_cost_usd is not a provider-enforced spend ceiling.
Workspace-write execution is not an OS/container boundary; Codex execution remains disabled unless the host enables and consents to it.
